1Ayodhya Kanda 31.1
एवम् श्रुत्वा तु सम्वादम् लक्ष्मणः पूर्वमागतः |बाष्पपर्याकुलमुखः शोकम् सोढुमशक्नुवन्
evam śrutvā tu samvādam lakṣmaṇaḥ pūrvamāgataḥ |bāṣpaparyākulamukhaḥ śokam soḍhumaśaknuvan
Lakshmana who came there earlier, heard the conversation of Seetha and Rama, having
his eyes glut with tears, being unable to bear the anguish, tightly pressed the feet of his bother
and spoke (as floows) to Rama who was performing a great vow and to Seetha who enjoyed great
honour.


Word by word
1;2. lakshhmaNaH= Lakshmana;aagataH= who came there;puurvam= earlier;shrutvaa= heard;samvaadam= the conversation;evam= thus;bhaashhpa paryaakulekshhanaH= having his eyes filled with tears;ashaknuvan= being unable;sodhum= to bear;shokam= the anguish;saH= that;raghunandanaH= Lakshmana;nipiidya= pressed;charaNau= the feet;bhraatuH= of his brother;gaadham= firmly;uvaacha= spoke;raaghavamcha= to Rama;mahaavratam= performing a
great vow;siitaam= and to Seetha;atiyashaam= of great honour.




2Ayodhya Kanda 31.2
स भ्रातुश्चरणौ गाढम् निपीड्य रघुनन्दनः |सीतामुवाचातियशाम् राघवम् च महाव्रतम्
sa bhrātuścaraṇau gāḍham nipīḍya raghunandanaḥ |sītāmuvācātiyaśām rāghavam ca mahāvratam
The source page does not carry a separate English translation for this shloka. The Devanagari and IAST are complete.


3Ayodhya Kanda 31.3
यदि गन्तुम् कृता बुद्धिर्वनम् मृगगजायुतम् |अहम् त्वानुगमिष्यामि वनमद्रे धनुर्धरः
yadi gantum kṛtā buddhirvanam mṛgagajāyutam |aham tvānugamiṣyāmi vanamadre dhanurdharaḥ
"If you decided to go to the forest filled with antelopes and elephants, I, in front
wearingthe bow, shall accompany you to the forest."


Word by word
3. buddhiH kR^itaayadi= If decision was made;gantum= to
go;vanam= to forest;mR^igagajaayutam= filled with antelopes and elephants;aham= I;dhanurdharaH= wearing the bow;agre= in front;anugamishhyaami= shall accompany;tvaa= your;vanam= to forest.




4Ayodhya Kanda 31.4
मया समेतोऽरण्यानि बहूनि विचरिष्यसि |पक्षिभिर्मृगयूथैश्च सम्घुष्टानि समन्ततः
mayā sameto.araṇyāni bahūni vicariṣyasi |pakṣibhirmṛgayūthaiśca samghuṣṭāni samantataḥ
"Together with me, you will travel in the various forests, resonant with sounds of
birds and herds of wild animals."


Word by word
4. sametaH= together;mayaa= with me;vicharishhyasi= you will travel;bahuuni araNyaani= in many forests;samghushhTaani= resonant;samastataH= of all;pakshhibhiH= birds;mR^igayoothaiH= and troops of wild animals.




5Ayodhya Kanda 31.5
न देवलोकाक्रमणम् नामरत्वमहम् वृणे |ऐश्वर्यम् वापि लोकानाम् कामये न त्वया विना
na devalokākramaṇam nāmaratvamaham vṛṇe |aiśvaryam vāpi lokānām kāmaye na tvayā vinā
"Without you, I do not want ascendency to heaven now do I desire immortality now do
I wish for sovereignity over the globes."


Word by word
5. tvayaa vinaa= without you;aham= I;navR^iNe=
do not want;devalokakramaNam= ascendency to heaven;na= nor desiring;amaratvam= immortality;na kaamaye= now wishing;aishvaryam vaapi=
even sovereignity;lokaanaam= over the globes.




6Ayodhya Kanda 31.6
एवम् ब्रुवाणः सौमित्रिर्विनवासाय निश्चितः |रामेण बहुभिः सान्वैर्निषिद्धः पुनरब्रवीत्
evam bruvāṇaḥ saumitrirvinavāsāya niścitaḥ |rāmeṇa bahubhiḥ sānvairniṣiddhaḥ punarabravīt
Lakshmana who was speaking in favour of coming to the forst, was forbidden by Rama
through many of his pacifying words. After hearing them, Lakshmana again soke as follows:


Word by word
6. saumitriH= Lakshmana;bruvaaNaH= who was speaking;evam= thus;nishchitaH= determined;vanavaasaaya= to dwell in the
forest;nishhiddhaH= was forbidden;raameNa= by Rama;bahubhiH
saantvaiH= through many pacifying words;punaH= again;abraviit=
spoke.




7Ayodhya Kanda 31.7
अनुज्ञातश्च भवता पूर्वमेव यदस्म्यहम् |किमिदानीम् पुनरिदम् क्रियते मे निवारणम्
anujñātaśca bhavatā pūrvameva yadasmyaham |kimidānīm punaridam kriyate me nivāraṇam
"I was indeed permitted by you earlier. How is it that you are prohibiting me
now?"


Word by word
7. aham= I;asmiyat= am indeed;anujJNaataH=
permitted;bhavataa= by you;puurvameva= even earlier;idaaniim= now;kim= why;punaH= again;idam= this;nivaaraNam= hindrance;kriyate= is being done?




8Ayodhya Kanda 31.8
यदर्थम् प्रतिषेधो मे क्रियते गन्तुमिच्छतः |एतदिच्छामि विज्ञातुम् संशयो हि ममानघ
yadartham pratiṣedho me kriyate gantumicchataḥ |etadicchāmi vijñātum saṃśayo hi mamānagha
"Oh, the faultless man! I desire to know the reason for prohibiting me, who is
indeed willing to come to the forest, because there is doubt in my mind."


Word by word
8. anagha= Oh;the faultless man! ichchhaami= I desire;vijJNaatum= to know;yadartham= for what reason;pratishhedhaH=
prohibition;kriyate= is done;etat= at this time;me= for me;ichhataH= who is willing;gautum= to go;samshayaH hi= there is
indeed doubt;me= in me.




9Ayodhya Kanda 31.9
ततः अब्रवीन् महा तेजा रामः लक्ष्मणम् अग्रतः |स्थितम् प्राग् गामिनम् वीरम् याचमानम् कृत अन्जलिम्
tataḥ abravīn mahā tejā rāmaḥ lakṣmaṇam agrataḥ |sthitam prāg gāminam vīram yācamānam kṛta anjalim
Thereafter Rama of great splendour spoke to Lakshmana the valiant man who was
standing in front, intending to preceede Sri Rama and soliciting with joined palms.


Word by word
9. tataH= thenafter;raamaH= Rama;mahaatejaaH=
of great splendour;abraviit= spoke;lakshhmaNam= to Lakshmana;sthitam= standing;agrataH= in front;praaggaaminam= intending to go
before;viiram= the valiant man;yaachamaanam= soliciting;kR^itaaNjalim= with joined palms.




10Ayodhya Kanda 31.10
स्निग्धो धर्मरतो वीरस्सततम् सत्पथे स्थितः |प्रियः प्राणसमो वशो भ्राता चापि सखा च मे
snigdho dharmarato vīrassatatam satpathe sthitaḥ |priyaḥ prāṇasamo vaśo bhrātā cāpi sakhā ca me
"You are so friendly, interested in righteousness, valiant, abiding always in a good
path, dear to me as life, obedient, my brother and a companion."


Word by word
10. snigdhaH= friendly;dharmarataH= interested in
righeousness;viiraH= valiant;sthitaH= always;satpathe= in good
path;priyaH= the beloved one;praaNa samaH= as dear as life;vashyaH= obedient;bhraatraachaapi= the brother;sakhaacha= and a companion.




11Ayodhya Kanda 31.11
मया अद्य सह सौमित्रे त्वयि गच्चति तत् वनम् |को भरिष्यति कौसल्याम् सुमित्राम् वा यशस्विनीम्
mayā adya saha saumitre tvayi gaccati tat vanam |ko bhariṣyati kausalyām sumitrām vā yaśasvinīm
"Oh Lakshmana! If you proceed to the forest along with me now, who will support
Kausalya or the illustrious Sumitra?"


Word by word
11. saumitre= Oh;Lakshmana! tvayi= you;gachchhati= having proceeded;tatvanam= to that forest;mayaa saha=
along with me;adya= now;kaH= who;bharishhyati= will support;kausalyaam= Kausalaya;sumitraam vaa= or Sumira;yashashiviniim= the
illustrious.




12Ayodhya Kanda 31.12
अभिवर्षति कामैः यः पर्जन्यः पृथिवीम् इव |स काम पाश पर्यस्तः महा तेजा मही पतिः
abhivarṣati kāmaiḥ yaḥ parjanyaḥ pṛthivīm iva |sa kāma pāśa paryastaḥ mahā tejā mahī patiḥ
"That emperor of great splendour, who used to shower blessings on the people as a
cloud sends down rain on the earth, stands circumscribed by cord of love."


Word by word
12. yaH= which;mahiipatiH= emporor;mahaatejaH=
of great splendour;abhivarshhati= used to shower;kaamaiH= objects of desire;parjanyaH iva= as a cloud;pR^ithiviim= to the earth;saH= he;kaamapaashaparyantaH= stands circumscribed by cord of love.




13Ayodhya Kanda 31.13
सा हि राज्यम् इदम् प्राप्य नृपस्य अश्व पतेः सुता |दुह्खितानाम् सपत्नीनाम् न करिष्यति शोभनम्
sā hi rājyam idam prāpya nṛpasya aśva pateḥ sutā |duhkhitānām sapatnīnām na kariṣyati śobhanam
"That Kaikeyi daughter of king Aswapathi, after obtaining this kingdom, will

  Overhearing the conversation of Rama and Seetha, Lakshmana who came there earlier enters into dialogue with his brother, insisting that he too shall accompany Rama and Seetha to forests. Rama tries to persuade him to stay back, in vain. Then Rama had to agree to Lakshmana's insistence and asks him to fetch the divine bows, arrows and swords given by gods in the Vedic-ritual of Seetha's father, namely King Janaka.

mṛgāḥ simhā gajāścaiva śārdūlāḥ śarabhāstathā |pakṣiṇaḥ sṛmarāścaiva ye cānye vanacāriṇaḥ
"Oh Rama! Antelopes, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas(legendary animal with eight
legs), birds, yaks and all others which roam in the forest, run away after seeing your form, since
they have never seen your figure before. When there is cause for fear, who would not have
fear?"

to be more powerful than the lion);pakshhiNaH= birds;sR^iimaraashchaiva=

ruupatvaat= since they have never seen your figure;before;bhaye= when there is

4Ayodhya Kanda 29.4
अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात्सर्वे ते तव राघव |रूपम् दृष्ट्वापसर्पेयुर्भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति

5Ayodhya Kanda 29.5
त्वया च सह गन्तव्यम् मया गुरु जन आज्ञया |त्वद् वियोगेन मे राम त्यक्तव्यम् इह जीवितम्
tvayā ca saha gantavyam mayā guru jana ājñayā |tvad viyogena me rāma tyaktavyam iha jīvitam
"Oh, Rama! As per the command of the elders, I also should go along with you. My
life is to be abandoned here, if I were separated from you."

6Ayodhya Kanda 29.6
न च माम् त्वत् समीपस्थम् अपि शक्नोति राघव |सुराणाम् ईश्वरः शक्रः प्रधर्षयितुम् ओजसा
na ca mām tvat samīpastham api śaknoti rāghava |surāṇām īśvaraḥ śakraḥ pradharṣayitum ojasā
"Oh Rama! Even Devendra the Lord of celestials, by his strength, cannot over power
me, who is in your vicinity."

7Ayodhya Kanda 29.7
पति हीना तु या नारी न सा शक्ष्यति जीवितुम् |कामम् एवम् विधम् राम त्वया मम विदर्शितम्
pati hīnā tu yā nārī na sā śakṣyati jīvitum |kāmam evam vidham rāma tvayā mama vidarśitam
"Oh Rama! Verily such a thing was taught to me by you, that a woman disunited from
her husband should not be able to survive."

husband;saa= she;na shakshhyati= should not be able;jiivitum= to
live;raama= Oh;Rama! kaamam= verily;evam vidham= such a thing;vidarshitam= was taught;mama= to me;tvayaa= by you.




8Ayodhya Kanda 29.8
अथ च अपि महा प्राज्ञ ब्राह्मणानाम् मया श्रुतम् |पुरा पितृ गृहे सत्यम् वस्तव्यम् किल मे वने
atha ca api mahā prājña brāhmaṇānām mayā śrutam |purā pitṛ gṛhe satyam vastavyam kila me vane
"Oh Rama, the very wise! Besides, formerly in my father's house it was heard by me

9Ayodhya Kanda 29.9
लक्षणिभ्यो द्विजातिभ्यः श्रुत्वा अहम् वचनम् गृहे |वन वास कृत उत्साहा नित्यम् एव महा बल
lakṣaṇibhyo dvijātibhyaḥ śrutvā aham vacanam gṛhe |vana vāsa kṛta utsāhā nityam eva mahā bala
"Oh Rama the man of great strength! Ever since I heard this word from brahmanas who

10Ayodhya Kanda 29.10
आदेशो वन वासस्य प्राप्तव्यः स मया किल |सा त्वया सह तत्र अहम् यास्यामि प्रिय न अन्यथा
ādeśo vana vāsasya prāptavyaḥ sa mayā kila |sā tvayā saha tatra aham yāsyāmi priya na anyathā
"Oh, Rama the beloved! That prediction of dwelling in the forst is to be realised by
me. I must accordingly accompany you to the forest, it cannot be otherwise."


Word by word

prediction;vanavaasasya= of dwelling in the forst praaptavyaH kila = is to be realised

11Ayodhya Kanda 29.11
कृत आदेशा भविष्यामि गमिष्यामि सह त्वया |कालः च अयम् समुत्पन्नः सत्य वाग् भवतु द्विजः
kṛta ādeśā bhaviṣyāmi gamiṣyāmi saha tvayā |kālaḥ ca ayam samutpannaḥ satya vāg bhavatu dvijaḥ
"I shall be the one who has fulfilled the brahmana's word. I shall accompany you to
the forest. The time has come for brahmana's words to come true."

12Ayodhya Kanda 29.12
वन वासे हि जानामि दुह्खानि बहुधा किल |प्राप्यन्ते नियतम् वीर पुरुषैः अकृत आत्मभिः
vana vāse hi jānāmi duhkhāni bahudhā kila |prāpyante niyatam vīra puruṣaiḥ akṛta ātmabhiḥ
"Oh valiant prince! I know that in the forest, sufferings indeed are many and are
invariably obtained by men having unformed minds."

13Ayodhya Kanda 29.13
कन्यया च पितुर् गेहे वन वासः श्रुतः मयाभिक्षिण्याः साधु वृत्ताया मम मातुर् इह अग्रतः

"While I was an unmarried girl, the prediction about my dwelling the forest was

14Ayodhya Kanda 29.14
प्रसादितः च वै पूर्वम् त्वम् वै बहु विधम् प्रभो |गमनम् वन वासस्य कान्क्षितम् हि सह त्वया
prasāditaḥ ca vai pūrvam tvam vai bahu vidham prabho |gamanam vana vāsasya kānkṣitam hi saha tvayā
"Oh Lord! In the past, you have been really pleased for many a time to take me along
with you indeed for the tour of a forest, as longed by me."

15Ayodhya Kanda 29.15
कृत क्षणा अहम् भद्रम् ते गमनम् प्रति राघव |वन वासस्य शूरस्य चर्या हि मम रोचते
kṛta kṣaṇā aham bhadram te gamanam prati rāghava |vana vāsasya śūrasya caryā hi mama rocate
"Oh, Rama! May all be well with you! I am waiting for a journey to the forest. A
work-out of adventurist is really delightful to me."

16Ayodhya Kanda 29.16
शुद्ध आत्मन् प्रेम भावाद्द् हि भविष्यामि विकल्मषा |भर्तारम् अनुगच्चन्ती भर्ता हि मम दैवतम्
śuddha ātman prema bhāvādd hi bhaviṣyāmi vikalmaṣā |bhartāram anugaccantī bhartā hi mama daivatam
"Oh, the pure-minded! Following my husband with loving devotion, I shall become
sin-less; for husband is the supreme deity to me."


Word by word
16. shuddhaatman= Oh;the pure-minded! prema bhaavaat hi=
by loving devotion;anugachchhantii= following;bhartaaram= you;the husband;bhavishhyaami= I shall become;vikalmashhaa= sinless;mama= to me;bhartaa= husband;daivatam hi= is supreme deity.




17Ayodhya Kanda 29.17
प्रेत्य भावे अपि कल्याणः सम्गमः मे सह त्वया |श्रुतिर् हि श्रूयते पुण्या ब्राह्मणानाम् यशस्विनाम्
pretya bhāve api kalyāṇaḥ samgamaḥ me saha tvayā |śrutir hi śrūyate puṇyā brāhmaṇānām yaśasvinām

words of brahmanas is being heard thus:- In this world, which woman was given away to whom by
parents with water according to the moral code binding on them, that woman belongs to him alone
even after death.

auspicions;saNgamaH= union;me= to me;tvayaa saha= with you;puNyaa= meritoins;shrutiH= words of Veda;brahmaNaam= by brahmanas;shruuyate hi= being heard indeed;mahaamate= Oh;the great minded! yaa
strii= which woman;iha loke= in this world;dattaa= was given away;yasya= to who;adbhiH= with water;pitR^ibhiH= by her parents;svadharmeNa= according to the moral code;tasya= to him;saa=

इह लोके च पितृभिर् या स्त्री यस्य महा मते |अद्भिर् दत्ता स्वधर्मेण प्रेत्य भावे अपि तस्य सा
iha loke ca pitṛbhir yā strī yasya mahā mate |adbhir dattā svadharmeṇa pretya bhāve api tasya sā
The source page does not carry a separate English translation for this shloka. The Devanagari and IAST are complete.


19Ayodhya Kanda 29.19
एवम् अस्मात् स्वकाम् नारीम् सुवृत्ताम् हि पति व्रताम् |न अभिरोचयसे नेतुम् त्वम् माम् केन इह हेतुना
evam asmāt svakām nārīm suvṛttām hi pati vratām |na abhirocayase netum tvam mām kena iha hetunā
"By what reason now are you thus not willing to take me, the woman having good
conduct, devoted to her husband and belonging to you, from this place?"


Word by word

20Ayodhya Kanda 29.20
भक्ताम् पति व्रताम् दीनाम् माम् समाम् सुख दुह्खयोह् |नेतुम् अर्हसि काकुत्स्थ समान सुख दुह्खिनीम्
bhaktām pati vratām dīnām mām samām sukha duhkhayoh |netum arhasi kākutstha samāna sukha duhkhinīm
"Oh Rama, the seion of Kakutsa! You ought to take me, who is a devotee, so devoted
to husband, who is distressed who feels alike in pleasure and pain and shares your joys and
sorrows."


Word by word
20. kaakutthsa= Oh;the seion of Kakustha! arhasi= you
ought to;netum= take;maam= me;bhaktaam= who is a devotee;pativrataam= devoted to husband;diinaam= who is distressed;samaam=
who is equal;sukhaduHkhayoH= in pleasure and pain;samaana sukhaduHkhaniim=
sharing in your joys and sorrows.




21Ayodhya Kanda 29.21
यदि माम् दुह्खिताम् एवम् वनम् नेतुम् न च इच्चसि |विषम् अग्निम् जलम् वा अहम् आस्थास्ये मृत्यु कारणात्
yadi mām duhkhitām evam vanam netum na ca iccasi |viṣam agnim jalam vā aham āsthāsye mṛtyu kāraṇāt
"I shall take resort to poison or fire or water for dying, if you are not willing to
take me, afflicted as I am, as above."


Word by word
21. aasthaasye= I shall take resort to;vishham= poison
or;agnim= fire or;jalamvaa= water;mR^ityukaaraNaat= for dying;nachaichchhasiyadi= if you are not willing;netum= to take;maam= me;duHkhitaam= afflicted as I am;evam= as above.




22Ayodhya Kanda 29.22
एवम् बहु विधम् तम् सा याचते गमनम् प्रति |न अनुमेने महा बाहुस् ताम् नेतुम् विजनम् वनम्
evam bahu vidham tam sā yācate gamanam prati |na anumene mahā bāhus tām netum vijanam vanam
Eventhough she requested him in many ways about setting out to the forest, he did
not agree to take her to the forest, which is a solitary place.


Word by word
22. saa= she;evam= thus yaachate = requested;tam= him;bahuvidham= in many ways;gamanam prati= about setting
out(to the forst) mahaabaahuH = Rama;the long armed;naamnumane= did not agree;netum= to take;taam= her;vanam= to forest;vijanam= which
is a solitary place.




23Ayodhya Kanda 29.23
एवम् उक्ता तु सा चिन्ताम् मैथिली समुपागता |स्नापयन्ती इव गाम् उष्णैः अश्रुभिर् नयन च्युतैः
evam uktā tu sā cintām maithilī samupāgatā |snāpayantī iva gām uṣṇaiḥ aśrubhir nayana cyutaiḥ
After hearing Rama's words, seetha was sorrowful, moistening with earth as it were
with burning tears, trickling down her eyes.


Word by word

with earth;snaapayantiiva= as though wet;ushhNaiHashrubhiH= by burning tears;nayanachyntaiH= trickling down from her eyes.




24Ayodhya Kanda 29.24
चिन्तयन्तीम् तथा ताम् तु निवर्तयितुम् आत्मवान् |ताम्रोष्ठीं स तदा सीताम् काकुत्स्थो बह्व् असान्त्वयत्
cintayantīm tathā tām tu nivartayitum ātmavān |tāmroṣṭhīṃ sa tadā sītām kākutstho bahv asāntvayat
Rama the prudent man then pacified in many ways, to avert that Seetha with red lips,
who was sorrowful as above.


Word by word
24. saH kakutthsaH= that Rama;aatmavaan= the prudent man;tadaa= then;asaantvayat= pacified;bahu= in many ways;nivartiyutum= to avert;taam siitaam = that Seetha;taamroshhThiim= with red
lips;chintayantiim= who was sorrowful;tathaa= as above.



    
  
  Seetha implores upon Rama to allow her to come to forests, and says that she heard through some foretellers that she has to live in forests for some time, when she was with her father's place. But Rama is not interested to make Seetha's life penurious in forests and once again tries to pacify her. He asks her to stay back at Ayodhya. For that Seetha laments to become lonely parted with her husband.

"Oh, noble prince! Father, mother, brother, son and daughter-in-law accomplish their

4Ayodhya Kanda 27.4

bhartur bhāgyam tu bhāryā ekā prāpnoti puruṣa ṛṣabha |ataḥ caiva aham ādiṣṭā vane vastavyam iti api
"Oh, Rama the best of men! Wife for one gets fortune of the husband. For that
reason, I am also destined to dwell in the forest."

yadi tvam prasthitaḥ durgam vanam adya eva rāghava |agrataḥ te gamiṣyāmi mṛdnantī kuśa kaṇṭakān
"Oh, Rama! If you set forth now itself to the forest, which is difficult to be

phala mūla aśanā nityam bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ |na te duhkham kariṣyāmi nivasantī saha tvayā

haṃsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇāḥ padminīḥ sādhu puṣpitāḥ |icceyam sukhinī draṣṭum tvayā vīreṇa samgatā

aham gamiṣyāmi vanam sudurgamam |mṛga āyutam vānara vāraṇaiḥ yutam |vane nivatsyāmi yathā pitur gṛhe |tava eva pādāv upagṛhya sammatā

ananya bhāvām anurakta cetasam |tvayā viyuktām maraṇāya niścitām |nayasva mām sādhu kuruṣva yācanām |na te mayā ataḥ gurutā bhaviṣyati
"Therefore, grant well my prayer and usher me- me without any other thought, whose

1Ayodhya Kanda 25.1
सा अपनीय तम् आयासम् उपस्पृश्य जलम् शुचि |चकार माता रामस्य मन्गलानि मनस्विनी
sā apanīya tam āyāsam upaspṛśya jalam śuci |cakāra mātā rāmasya mangalāni manasvinī
Kausalya, the magnanimous mother putting away her grief, sipped water from the palm
of the hand, became purified and performed rites conducive to the welfare of Rama.

uvācātiprahṛṣṭeva sā duḥkhavaśartinīvāṅmātreṇa na bhāvena vācā saṃsajjamānayā

ānamya mūrdhni ca āghrāya pariṣvajya yaśasvinīavadat putra siddha artho gacca rāma yathā sukham
The illusrious Kausalya embraced Rama, smelling his head by bending it and spoke

अरोगम् सर्व सिद्ध अर्थम् अयोध्याम् पुनर् आगतम्पश्यामि त्वाम् सुखम् वत्स सुस्थितम् राज वेश्मनि
arogam sarva siddha artham ayodhyām punar āgatampaśyāmi tvām sukham vatsa susthitam rāja veśmani
Oh, son! With all your purposes fulfilled and with good health, I shall see you
returning to Ayodhya happily and taking over the reins of the kingdom

sarva siddhhartham = with all your purposes accomplished;pushyaami= I shall see;tvaam= you;punaH= again;aagatam= coming;ayodhyaam= to
Ayodhya;sukham= happily ;susthitam= well-established;raaja vartmani= in the path of a king

praṇaṣṭaduḥkhasaMkalpā harṣavidyotitānanādrakṣyāmi tvām vanātrpāptam pūrṇacandramivoditam
"All my thoughts of grief having been expulsed and my face shining with joy, I shall

भद्रासनगतम् राम वनवासादिहागतम्द्रक्षामि च पुनस्त्वाम् तु तीर्णवन्तम् पितुर्वचः

मया अर्चिता देव गणाः शिव आदयो |महर्षयो भूत महा असुर उरगाः |अभिप्रयातस्य वनम् चिराय ते|हितानि कान्क्षन्तु दिशः च राघव
mayā arcitā deva gaṇāḥ śiva ādayo |maharṣayo bhūta mahā asura uragāḥ |abhiprayātasya vanam cirāya te|hitāni kānkṣantu diśaḥ ca rāghava
"Oh, Rama! Worshipped by me, let the hosts of gods headed by Siva, the Supreme
Being, the great sages, spirits, the chief of evil spirits, the celestial serpents and the
(four)quarters wish well of you, who is setting forth to forest, "

इति इव च अश्रु प्रतिपूर्ण लोचना|समाप्य च स्वस्त्ययनम् यथा विधि |प्रदक्षिणम् चैव चकार राघवम् |पुनः पुनः च अपि निपीड्य सस्वजे
iti iva ca aśru pratipūrṇa locanā|samāpya ca svastyayanam yathā vidhi |pradakṣiṇam caiva cakāra rāghavam |punaḥ punaḥ ca api nipīḍya sasvaje
Having so said and having completed the rite of invoking blessings befittingly,
Kausalya whose eyes were overflowing with tears, further went clockwise around Rama and having
pressed close to him, embraced again and again.

punaHcha api= again and again.

तथा तु देव्या स कृत प्रदक्षिणो |निपीड्य मातुः चरणौ पुनः पुनः |जगाम सीता निलयम् महा यशाः |स राघवः प्रज्वलितः स्वया श्रिया
tathā tu devyā sa kṛta pradakṣiṇo |nipīḍya mātuḥ caraṇau punaḥ punaḥ |jagāma sītā nilayam mahā yaśāḥ |sa rāghavaḥ prajvalitaḥ svayā śriyā
Having been done circumbulation (as a mark of protection) thus by the pious woman
Kausalya, that highly illustrious Rama pressing his mother's feet again and again , shining by his
own splendour, went to Sita's house

  In this chapter Kausalya bids farewell to Rama preparing to go to forest. Rama leaves her residence and goes to Seetha.

  This chapter describes the valiant words of Lakshmana, his opposing depends on god and proposes to fight with Rama's enemies to endow Rama with Kingdom.

1Ayodhya Kanda 23.1
इति ब्रुवति रामे तु लक्ष्मणो अधः शिरा मुहुः |श्रुत्वा मध्यम् जगाम इव मनसा दुह्ख हर्षयोह्
iti bruvati rāme tu lakṣmaṇo adhaḥ śirā muhuḥ |śrutvā madhyam jagāma iva manasā duhkha harṣayoh
While Rama was thus speeding, Lakshmana heard, bowed down his head and got into the
midst of pain and pleasure effecting his mind again and again.

1. raame= Rama;iti= thus;brutvati= speading;lakshhmanaH= Lakshmana;shrutvaa= heard;adhaHshshriraaH= having his

tadā tu baddhvā bhrukuṭīm bhruvor madhye nara ṛṣabha |niśaśvāsa mahā sarpo bilasyaiva roṣitaḥ
Lakshmana then firmed up his eyebrows and sighed with frown, like an angry snake
from its hole.

2. narashhabhaH= Lakshmana;the best of men;tadaata tu=

tasya duṣprativīkṣyam tat bhrukuṭī sahitam tadā |babhau kruddhasya simhasya mukhasya sadṛśam mukham

an angry lion.

agrahaḥ tam vidhunvaṃs tu hastī hastam ivātmanaḥ |tiryag ūrdhvam śarīre ca pātayitvā śiraḥ dharāmagra akṣṇā vīkṣamāṇaḥ tu tiryag bhrātaram abravīt
Seeing Rama with the tip of his eyes obliquely, Lakshmana spoke to him moving his
forehand like an elephant moving its trunk and causing his head to fall in oblique and upward
direction.

"Oh, the best of proud military community! This untimely great confusion is born in

my sword;adraya iva= like mountains;diipyamaanaaH= in blaze;meghaaiva= like lcouds;savidyutaH= with flashes of lightening.




34Ayodhya Kanda 23.34
खड्ग धारा हता मे अद्य दीप्यमानाइव अद्रयः |पतिष्यन्ति द्विपा भूमौ मेघाइव सविद्युतः
khaḍga dhārā hatā me adya dīpyamānāiva adrayaḥ |patiṣyanti dvipā bhūmau meghāiva savidyutaḥ
"As I stand holding a bow with fingers wound with shields made of allegator-skin,
how any man will fancy himself a hero among men?"


Word by word
34. mayi= I;sthite= having stood;pragaR^ihiitasharaasane= holding forth a bow;baddha godhaaNgnLitraaNe= with
fingers wound with sheathing made of alligator skin;katham= how;syaat= one
will be;purushhamaanii= faneying himself a hero;purushhaNaam= among men?




35Ayodhya Kanda 23.35
बद्ध गोधा अन्गुलि त्राणे प्रगृहीत शर आसने |कथम् पुरुष मानी स्यात् पुरुषाणाम् मयि स्थिते
baddha godhā anguli trāṇe pragṛhīta śara āsane |katham puruṣa mānī syāt puruṣāṇām mayi sthite
"While I overpower one with many arrows and many with a single arrow, I discharge my
arrows at vitals of men, horses and elephants."


Word by word
35. aham= I;atyasyan= shall over power;ekam=
one;babhubhiH= with many arrows;bahuun= many;ekena= with single
arrow;viniyokshhyaami= discharging;baanaan= arrows at;nR^ivaajigaja
marmasu= vitals of men;horses and elephants.




36Ayodhya Kanda 23.36
बहुभिः च एकम् अत्यस्यन्न् एकेन च बहून् जनान् |विनियोक्ष्याम्य् अहम् बाणान् नृ वाजि गज मर्मसु
bahubhiḥ ca ekam atyasyann ekena ca bahūn janān |viniyokṣyāmy aham bāṇān nṛ vāji gaja marmasu
"Oh, Lord! Today, the strength of my excellent arrows is capable of making you
sovereign and making Dasaratha devoid of power."


Word by word
36. prabhuu= Oh;Lord! adya= today;me= my;prabhaavaH= strength;astra prabhaavasya= of excellent arrows;prabhavishhyati= is capable;kartum= to make;tava= you;prabhutvam cha= the supreme power and raajJNyaH = to king Dasaratha;aprabhutaam= devoid of power.




37Ayodhya Kanda 23.37
अद्य मे अस्त्र प्रभावस्य प्रभावः प्रभविष्यति |राज्ञः च अप्रभुताम् कर्तुम् प्रभुत्वम् च तव प्रभो
adya me astra prabhāvasya prabhāvaḥ prabhaviṣyati |rājñaḥ ca aprabhutām kartum prabhutvam ca tava prabho
" Oh, Lord Rama! Today the effect of my weapons will remove the power from the king
Dasaratha and give the lordship to you."


Word by word
37. prabho= Oh;Lord Rama! adya= today;me
astraprabhaavasy= the effect of my weapons;prabhaavaH= prowess;raajJNaH
aprabhutaam= non lordship of king;kartum= to do;tava brabhutyamcha=
government to you;prabhavishhyati= has the power.




38Ayodhya Kanda 23.38
अद्य चन्दन सारस्य केयूरा मोक्षणस्य च |वसूनाम् च विमोक्षस्य सुह्ऱ्दाम् पालनस्य च
adya candana sārasya keyūrā mokṣaṇasya ca |vasūnām ca vimokṣasya suhRdām pālanasya ca
"Oh, Rama! These arms worthy of wearing sandalwood essence and bracelets; for
bestowing riches and for protection of friends can today do every action to prevent the agents who
want to obstruct your coronation."


Word by word
38;39. raama= Oh;Rama! adya= today;imau=
these;baahuu= arms;anuruupau= worthy of;chandana saarasya=
sandalwood essence;keyuuraamokshhaNasya= fo wearing breacelets;vimokshhasya=
for bestowal of ;vasuunaam= riches;paalanasya= for protection of;suhR^idaam= friends;karishhyataH= can do;darma= action;nivaaraNe= of preventing;kartR^iiNaam= the agents;abhishhekavighnasya= who obstruct your coronation.




39Ayodhya Kanda 23.39
अनुरूपाव् इमौ बाहू राम कर्म करिष्यतः |अभिषेचन विघ्नस्य कर्तृउणाम् ते निवारणे
anurūpāv imau bāhū rāma karma kariṣyataḥ |abhiṣecana vighnasya kartṛuṇām te nivāraṇe
The source page does not carry a separate English translation for this shloka. The Devanagari and IAST are complete.


40Ayodhya Kanda 23.40
ब्रवीहि को अद्य एव मया वियुज्यताम् |तव असुह्ऱ्द् प्राण यशः सुह्ऱ्ज् जनैः |यथा तव इयम् वसुधा वशे भवेत् |तथा एव माम् शाधि तव अस्मि किम्करः
bravīhi ko adya eva mayā viyujyatām |tava asuhRd prāṇa yaśaḥ suhRj janaiḥ |yathā tava iyam vasudhā vaśe bhavet |tathā eva mām śādhi tava asmi kimkaraḥ
"Tell me now itself who your enemy be made deprived of life, honour and friendship,
by me. Command me so that how this earth will become your dominion. I am your servant.


Word by word
40. braviihi= tell;kaH= who;tava= your;asuhR^it= enemy;viyujyataam= be made deprived of;praaNayashassuhT^ijjanaiH= life;honour and friends;adyaiva= now itself;mayaa= by me;shaadhi= command;maama= me;tathaiva= so
that;yathaa= how;iyam= this;vasudhaa= earth;bhavet=
will become;tava= your;vashe= dominion;kinkaraH asmi= I am
servant;tava= to you.




41Ayodhya Kanda 23.41
विम्ऱ्ज्य बाष्पम् परिसान्त्व्य च असकृत् |स लक्ष्मणम् राघव वंश वर्धनः |उवाच पित्र्ये वचने व्यवस्थितम् |निबोध माम् एष हि सौम्य सत् पथः
vimRjya bāṣpam parisāntvya ca asakṛt |sa lakṣmaṇam rāghava vaṃśa vardhanaḥ |uvāca pitrye vacane vyavasthitam |nibodha mām eṣa hi saumya sat pathaḥ
Then, Rama spoke thus to Lakshmana after consoling him time and again by weeping off
his tears; "Oh, Lakshmana! I stand by the words of our father. This indeed is a good path."


Word by word
41. saH= that;raaghavamsha vardhanaH= Rama;who is the
cause for increasing Raghu dynasty;uvaacha= spoke;lakshhmaNam= to Lakshmana;parisaantvyacha= after consoling;asakR^it= time and again;vimR^ijya= by wiping off;bhaashpam= tears;soumya= Oh;excellent man! nibodha= know;maam= me;vyavasthitam= who has stood;vachane= by word;pitryaiH= of father;eshhaH= this;satpathaH hi= indeed is good
path!



    
  
  This chapter describes the valiant words of Lakshmana, his opposing depends on god and proposes to fight with Rama's enemies to endow Rama with Kingdom.

1Ayodhya Kanda 21.1
तथा तु विलपन्तीम् ताम् कौसल्याम् राम मातरम् |उवाच लक्ष्मणो दीनः तत् काल सदृशम् वचः
tathā tu vilapantīm tām kausalyām rāma mātaram |uvāca lakṣmaṇo dīnaḥ tat kāla sadṛśam vacaḥ
Lakshmana became dejected and spoke these words, properly befitting for that time, to
that Rama's mother Kausalya who was thus weeping.


Word by word
1. lakshhmaNaH= Lakshmana;diinaH= became dejected;uvaacha= spoke;vachaH= the words;tatkaala sadR^isham= suitable for that time;taam 
kausalyyaam= to that kausalya;rama maataram= Rama's mother;tathaa= thus;vilapantiim= weaping.




2Ayodhya Kanda 21.2
न रोचते मम अपि एतत् आर्ये यद् राघवो वनम् |त्यक्त्वा राज्य श्रियम् गच्चेत् स्त्रिया वाक्य वशम् गतः
na rocate mama api etat ārye yad rāghavo vanam |tyaktvā rājya śriyam gaccet striyā vākya vaśam gataḥ
"Oh, the honoured lady ! I also do not like Rama to be influenced by the words of a woman
and go to the forest, leaving the prosperous kingdom."


Word by word
2. "aarye= Oh;the venerable lady! atat= this;na rochate= is not liking;mamaapi= to me also;itiyat= as in the manner this;raaghavaH= Rama;vaakyaarasham gataH= being influenced by the words;striyaaH= of a woman;gachchhet= go;vanam= to forest;tyaktvaa= leaving;raajya sriiyam= prosperous kingdom."




3Ayodhya Kanda 21.3
विपरीतः च वृद्धः च विषयैः च प्रधर्षितः |नृपः किम् इव न ब्रूयाच् चोद्यमानः समन्मथः
viparītaḥ ca vṛddhaḥ ca viṣayaiḥ ca pradharṣitaḥ |nṛpaḥ kim iva na brūyāc codyamānaḥ samanmathaḥ
"The king with perverted mind, of old age, one who is outraged by sensual enjoyments
and possessed of passion can talk any thing, prompted by Kaikeyi."


Word by word
3. "nR^ipaH= king;vipariitasheha= with perverted mind;vR^idhdhhashcha= old aged;pradharshhitaH= who is outraged;vishhayaiH= by 
sensual enjoyments;samanimadhaH= who is possessed of passion;na bruuyaat= can 
he not talk;kimiva= of anything;chodyamaanaH= prompted (by Kaikeyi).




4Ayodhya Kanda 21.4
न अस्य अपराधम् पश्यामि न अपि दोषम् तथा विधम् |येन निर्वास्यते राष्ट्रात् वन वासाय राघवः
na asya aparādham paśyāmi na api doṣam tathā vidham |yena nirvāsyate rāṣṭrāt vana vāsāya rāghavaḥ
"I can not see any offence or cause for blame in Rama that can expel him from the state
to the forest."


Word by word
4. na pashyaami= I can neither see;aparaadham= offence;na pashyaami= nor can I see;doshshamapi= even fault;asya= in him;tathaa vidham= that can;yena= by any means;nirvaasyate= expel;raaghavaH= Rama;raashhTraat= from state ;vanavaasaaya= to forest."




5Ayodhya Kanda 21.5
न तम् पश्याम्य् अहम् लोके परोक्षम् अपि यो नरः |स्वमित्रोऽपि निरस्तोऽपि योऽस्यदोषमुदाहरेत्
na tam paśyāmy aham loke parokṣam api yo naraḥ |svamitro.api nirasto.api yo.asyadoṣamudāharet
I have not seen in this world any person, whether an enemy or an expellee, speaking ill
of Rama indirectly."


Word by word
5. aham= I;na pashyaami= have not seen;loke= in 
this world;tam= such a person;udaaharet= who talks;dosham= ill;asya= of Rama;parokshhamapi= even indirectly;yaH naraH= that person who 
is;svamitro api= even an enemy;nirasto api= or an expellee."




6Ayodhya Kanda 21.6
देव कल्पम् ऋजुम् दान्तम् रिपूणाम् अपि वत्सलम् |अवेक्षमाणः को धर्मम् त्यजेत् पुत्रम् अकारणात्
deva kalpam ṛjum dāntam ripūṇām api vatsalam |avekṣamāṇaḥ ko dharmam tyajet putram akāraṇāt
"Can anybody observing ethicalness, causelessly get rid of a son who is equal to god
who is honest, who is self-restrained and who is affectionate even towards adversaries?"


Word by word
6. "kaH= who;avekshhamaaNaH= observing;dharmam= 
ethicalness;akaaraNaat= causelessly;tyajet= get rid of;putram= son;devakalpam= who is equal to god;R^ijum= who is honest;daantam= who is 
self-restrained;vatsalam= who is affectionate;R^ipuuNaamapi= even towards enemies?"




7Ayodhya Kanda 21.7
तत् इदम् वचनम् राज्ञः पुनर् बाल्यम् उपेयुषः |पुत्रः को हृदये कुर्यात् राज व्ऱ्त्तम् अनुस्मरन्
tat idam vacanam rājñaḥ punar bālyam upeyuṣaḥ |putraḥ ko hṛdaye kuryāt rāja vRttam anusmaran
"Which son, knowing royal usage, can agree to the words of this king who is behaving
as though he got childhood again?"


Word by word
7. "kaH= which son;anusmaran= who remembers;raja vR^ittam= royal usage;kuryaat= act;hR^idaye= with heart;tat idam vachanam= 
such of these words;raajJNaH= of king;upeyushhaH= who got;baalyam= 
childhood punaH = again?"




8Ayodhya Kanda 21.8
यावद् एव न जानाति कश्चित् अर्थम् इमम् नरः |तावद् एव मया साधम् आत्मस्थम् कुरु शासनम्
yāvad eva na jānāti kaścit artham imam naraḥ |tāvad eva mayā sādham ātmastham kuru śāsanam
"Even before others get to know about this matter, make this dominion your own, with
my help."


Word by word
8. "yaavadeva= even till;kashchit= any;naraH= person;na jaanaati= does not know;ivam artham= this matter;taava deva= in the 
mean time;kuru= make;shaasanam= dominion;aatmastham= your own;mayaa sa ardham= together with me."




9Ayodhya Kanda 21.9
मया पार्श्वे सधनुषा तव गुप्तस्य राघव |कः समर्थो अधिकम् कर्तुम् कृत अन्तस्य इव तिष्ठतः
mayā pārśve sadhanuṣā tava guptasya rāghava |kaḥ samartho adhikam kartum kṛta antasya iva tiṣṭhataḥ
"Oh, Rama! While I am standing by your side along with a bow, protecting you who are
standing as God of Death, who is capable of doing too much ?"


Word by word
9. raaghava= Oh;Rama! guptasya= protected;mayaa= by me ;parshve= on your side;sadhamshhaa= along with a bow;tishhThataH= you standing;kR^itaantasyeva= like Yama;the god of death;kaH= who;samarthaH= the competent one;kartum= to do;adhikam= too much?"




10Ayodhya Kanda 21.10
निर्मनुष्याम् इमाम् सर्वाम् अयोध्याम् मनुज ऋषभ |करिष्यामि शरैअः तीक्ष्णैः यदि स्थास्यति विप्रिये
nirmanuṣyām imām sarvām ayodhyām manuja ṛṣabha |kariṣyāmi śaraiaḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ yadi sthāsyati vipriye
"Oh, Rama, the best of men! If the city of Ayodhya turns against you, I shall make it
desolate of men with sharp arrows"


Word by word
10. manushharshhabha= Oh the best of men! sthaasyati yadi = If it stands;vipriye= disagreeable to you;karishhyaami= I shall make;imaam= this;kR^itsnaam= entire;ayodhyam= Ayodhya;nirmanushhyaam= deserted of people;sharaH tiikshhNaiH= with sharp arrows."




11Ayodhya Kanda 21.11
भरतस्य अथ पक्ष्यो वा यो वा अस्य हितम् इच्चति |सर्वान् एतान् वधिष्यामि मृदुर् हि परिभूयते
bharatasya atha pakṣyo vā yo vā asya hitam iccati |sarvān etān vadhiṣyāmi mṛdur hi paribhūyate
"I shall kill all those who are siding Bharata ,and are favourable to him. Soft person
indeed gets disgraced!"


Word by word
11. "atha= and vadhishhyaami = I shall kill;etaam sarvaan= 
all those;pakshhyovaa= who are siding;bharatasya= Bharata;yovaa= and 
who;ichchhati= desire;asya= his;hitam= benefit;mR^iduH= 
soft person;paribhuuyate hi= indeed gets disgraced."




12Ayodhya Kanda 21.12
प्रोत्साहितोऽयम् कैकेय्या स दुष्टो यदिः पिता |अमित्रभूतो निस्सङ्गम् वध्यताम् बध्यतामपि
protsāhito.ayam kaikeyyā sa duṣṭo yadiḥ pitā |amitrabhūto nissaṅgam vadhyatām badhyatāmapi
"If our father with an evil mind behaves like our enemy with instigation by Kaikeyi.
I shall keep him imprisoned with out personal attachment or if necessary, kill him."


Word by word
12. "protsaahitaH= Instigated;kaikeyyaa= by Kaikeyi saH = 
such of;naH putraa= our father;dushhTaH= as bad person;amitra bhuutaH= becomes enemy;ayam badhyataam= let him be imprisoned;mi ssaNgam= without personal 
attachment;vaadhyataamapi= and be killed!"




13Ayodhya Kanda 21.13
गुरोरप्यवलिप्तस्य कार्याकार्यमजानतः |उत्फथम् प्रतिपन्नस्य कार्यम् भवति शासन्म्
gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ |utphatham pratipannasya kāryam bhavati śāsanm
"Even a venerable person is to be punished, if he becomes arrogant, if he does not know
good and evil actions and if he takes to a wrong route."


Word by word
13. gurorapi= Even for a venerable person;avaliptasya= who 
is arrogant;ajaanataH= who does not know;kaaryaakaaryam= good and evil actions;pratipunnasya= who resorts to;utpatham= wrong route;shaasanam= punishment;bhavati= becomes;kaaryam= feasible."




14Ayodhya Kanda 21.14
बलमेष किमाश्रित्य हेतुम् वा पुरुषर्षभ |दातुमिच्छति कैकेय्य राज्यम् स्थितमिदम् तव
balameṣa kimāśritya hetum vā puruṣarṣabha |dātumicchati kaikeyya rājyam sthitamidam tava
"Oh, Rama, the best of men! On what strength or season has he taken shelter to give away
this kingdom belonging to you to Kaikeyi?"


Word by word
14. purushharshhabha= Oh the best of men! kim = what;balam= strength;hetum vaa= or reason;eshhaH= he;aastritya= has taken shelter;ichchhati= desiring ;daatum= to give;idam= this ;raajyam= 
kingdom;tava sthitam= belonging to you;kaikeyyai= for Kaikeyi.




15Ayodhya Kanda 21.15
त्वया चैव मया चैव कृत्वा वैरम् अनुत्तमम् |कस्य शक्तिः श्रियम् दातुम् भरताय अरि शासन
tvayā caiva mayā caiva kṛtvā vairam anuttamam |kasya śaktiḥ śriyam dātum bharatāya ari śāsana
"Oh, Rama the chestiser of enemies! Where is the ability for him to give kingdom to Bharata,
by making great enmity against you and me "


Word by word
15. arishaasana= Oh;the chastiser of enemies ! kaa shaktiH= what ability is there;asya= to him;daatum= to give;shriyam= high 
rank;bharataaya= to Bharata;kR^itvaa= by making;anuttamam= great;vairam= enmity;tvayaa chaiva= with you;mayaa chaiva= and with me."




16Ayodhya Kanda 21.16
अनुरक्तः अस्मि भावेन भ्रातरम् देवि तत्त्वतः |सत्येन धनुषा चैव दत्तेन इष्टेन ते शपे
anuraktaḥ asmi bhāvena bhrātaram devi tattvataḥ |satyena dhanuṣā caiva dattena iṣṭena te śape
"Oh, queen! Really, I am devotedly attached to my brother Rama. I am swearing an oath
to you by truth by bow, by the act of giving and by the act of sacrifice."


Word by word
16. devi= Oh;queen! tattvataH= really;anuraktaH asmi= I am attached;bhaavena= devotedly;bhraataram= my brother Rama;shape= I am swearing an oath;te= to you;satyena= by truth;dhanushhaachaiva= by bow;daltena= by the act of giving;ishhTena= by the act of sacrifice."

tam bāṣpa paripūrṇa akṣaḥ pRṣṭhataḥ anujagāma ha |lakṣmaṇaḥ parama kruddhaḥ sumitra ānanda vardhanaḥ
Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra, felt very angry with his eyes filled with tears and
accompanied behind Rama.


Word by word
30. lakshhmaNa= Lakshmana;sumitraananda vardhanaH= who
exhilarates sumitra's delight;paramakR^iddhaH= was very angry;bhaashhpa
paripuurNaakshhaH= with tearful eyes;anujagaamaH= accompanied;pR^ishhThataH= behind;tam= Rama;




31Ayodhya Kanda 19.31
आभिषेचनिकम् भाण्डम् क्ऱ्त्वा रामः प्रदक्षिणम् |शनैः जगाम सापेक्षो द्ऱ्ष्टिम् तत्र अविचालयन्
ābhiṣecanikam bhāṇḍam kRtvā rāmaḥ pradakṣiṇam |śanaiḥ jagāma sāpekṣo dRṣṭim tatra avicālayan
Rama did a circumbulatory salutation around the auspicious materials collected for
the propound coronation and having fixed his attention respectfully on them, moved away slowly.


Word by word
31. raamaH= Rama;pradakshhiNam kR^itvaa= did
circumbulatory salutation;bhaaNdam= around commodities;abhishhechanam=
collected coronation;dR^ishhTim= the glance;saapakshhaH= kept respectfully;avichaalayan= without deviation;tatra= on them;jagaama= moved away;shanaiH= slowly.




32Ayodhya Kanda 19.32
न च अस्य महतीम् लक्ष्मीम् राज्य नाशो अपकर्षति |लोक कान्तस्य कान्तत्वम् शीत रश्मेर् इव क्षपा
na ca asya mahatīm lakṣmīm rājya nāśo apakarṣati |loka kāntasya kāntatvam śīta raśmer iva kṣapā
As Rama was a pleasing personality, he was loved by all the people. The loss of
kingdom could not diminish such a great splendour of Rama as a night cannot diminish the splendour
of the moon.


Word by word
32. kaantatvaat= as pleasing personality;lokakaantasya=
he was loved by people;raajyanaashaH= loss of kingdom;na apakarshhati= could
not diminish;asya = his;mahatiim= great;lakshhmiim= splendour;khhapaa
eva= as a night;siina rashme= of moon's splendour.




33Ayodhya Kanda 19.33
न वनम् गन्तु कामस्य त्यजतः च वसुंधराम् |सर्व लोक अतिगस्य इव लक्ष्यते चित्त विक्रिया
na vanam gantu kāmasya tyajataḥ ca vasuṃdharām |sarva loka atigasya iva lakṣyate citta vikriyā
In that Rama, who was leaving the kingdom after having decided to go to the forest,
there was no perturbation of mind in him like in an ascetic who is beyond worldly pain and
pleasure.


Word by word
33. tyajatasya= in Rama;who was leaving;vasundharaam=
the earth;gantukaamasya= who decided to go;vanam= to forest;chittavikriya= perturbation of mind;na lakshhyate= was not seen;sarvalokaatigasyeva= like in an ascetic who is beyond all worlds.




34Ayodhya Kanda 19.34
प्रतिषिद्ध्य शुभम् छत्रं व्यजने च स्वलंकृते |विसर्जयित्वा स्वजनं रथम् पौरास्तथा जन्नान्
pratiṣiddhya śubham chatraṃ vyajane ca svalaṃkṛte |visarjayitvā svajanaṃ ratham paurāstathā jannān
Rama, the man of great courage, refused fans and umbrella, sent away his friends,
chariot and citizens kept back sorrow in his mind, subdued his senses and entered his mother's
house to inform the unpleasant news.


Word by word
34;35. aatmavaan= Rama the man of great;pratishhidhya=
refused;shubham= beautiful;chhatram= umbrella;svalaN^kR^ite= well
decorated;vyajanecha= fans;visarjayitvaa= sent away;svajanam= his
friends;ratham= chariot;tathaa= and;janaan= people;pouraan= relating to the city;dhaarayan= kept back;duHkham= sorrow;manasaa= in mind;nigR^ihasyacha= subdued;indriyaaNi= senses;pravivesha= entered;maatuH= mother's veshma = house;apriya
shamsivaan= to inform the unpleasent.




35Ayodhya Kanda 19.35
धारयन् मनसा दुह्खम् इन्द्रियाणि निग्ऱ्ह्य च |प्रविवेश आत्मवान् वेश्म मातुर प्रिय शंसिवान्
dhārayan manasā duhkham indriyāṇi nigRhya ca |praviveśa ātmavān veśma mātura priya śaṃsivān
The source page does not carry a separate English translation for this shloka. The Devanagari and IAST are complete.


36Ayodhya Kanda 19.36
सर्वो ह्यभिजनः श्रीमान् श्रीमतः सत्यवादिनः |नालक्षयत् रामस्य किंचिदाकारमानने
sarvo hyabhijanaḥ śrīmān śrīmataḥ satyavādinaḥ |nālakṣayat rāmasya kiṃcidākāramānane
The people adjacent to Rama could not visualise any change in the face of Rama who
was dignified and truthful in his words.


Word by word
36. sarvaH= all;abhijanaH= adjacent people;shriimaan= who were intelligent;naalakshhayata= could not see;kinchit= any small;aakaaram= hint;aanane= in the face;raamasya= of Rama;shriimataH= who was splendid;satyavaadinaH= who
spoke truth.




37Ayodhya Kanda 19.37
उचितम् च महाबाहुर्न जहौ हर्षमात्मनः |शारदः समुदीर्णांशुश्चन्द्रस्तेज इवात्मजम्
ucitam ca mahābāhurna jahau harṣamātmanaḥ |śāradaḥ samudīrṇāṃśuścandrasteja ivātmajam
Rama did not lose his natural joy, as an autumnal moon with lofty rays does not lose
its natural splendour.


Word by word
37. mahaabaahuH= Rama with great arms;najahau= did not
lose;aatmanaH= his;uchitam= usual;harshham= joy;tejaiva= as the splendour;aatmajam= that is natural;shaaradaH= of autumnal;chandraH= moon;diirghaamshuH= with lofty rays.




38Ayodhya Kanda 19.38
वाचा मधुरया रामः स्र्वं सम्मानयन् जनम् |मातुस्समीपं धीरात्मा प्रविवेश महायशाः
vācā madhurayā rāmaḥ srvaṃ sammānayan janam |mātussamīpaṃ dhīrātmā praviveśa mahāyaśāḥ
Rama with his courageous spirit and of great fame, paying his respects to the people
with his sweet words, went nearer to his mother.


Word by word
38. raamaH= Rama;dhiiraatmaa= with courageous spirit;mahaayashaaH= who is having great fame;sammaanayam= paying his respects;janam= to people;madhurayaa vaachaa= with sweet words;pravivesha=
went;samiipam= near to;maatuH= mother.




39Ayodhya Kanda 19.39
तं गुणैस्समतां प्राप्तो भ्राता विपुलविक्रमः |सौमित्रिरनुवव्राज धारयन् दुःखमात्मजम्
taṃ guṇaissamatāṃ prāpto bhrātā vipulavikramaḥ |saumitriranuvavrāja dhārayan duḥkhamātmajam
Lakshmana, who got virtues equal to Rama, who was having great heroic valour and who
was the brother, kept the grief within himself and went along with Rama.


Word by word
39. saumitriH= Lakshmana;praaptaH= who got;guNaiH= virtues;samataam= equal to (Rama);vipulavikramaH= who had
great heroic valour;bhraataa= who was the brother;dhaarayan= kept;duHkham= grief;aatmajam= born in his mind;anuvavraaja= went along
with;tam= that Rama.




40Ayodhya Kanda 19.40
प्रविश्य वेश्म अतिभ्ऱ्शम् मुदा अन्वितम् |समीक्ष्य ताम् च अर्थ विपत्तिम् आगताम् |न चैव रामः अत्र जगाम विक्रियाम् |सुह्ऱ्ज् जनस्य आत्म विपत्ति शन्कया
praviśya veśma atibhRśam mudā anvitam |samīkṣya tām ca artha vipattim āgatām |na caiva rāmaḥ atra jagāma vikriyām |suhRj janasya ātma vipatti śankayā
When Rama entered, Kausalya's palace was filled with great joy. At that time, Rama
did not show any displeasure for the mihlap occurred in truth. He behaved like that because he had
doubted about the possible shock to his friends even of fear of their life, if he showed any
perturabation.


Word by word
40. raamaH= Rama;pravishya= entered;veshma=
the house;anvitam= overpowered by;atbhR^isham= very exceeding;mudaa= delight;nachaiva jagaama= did not get;vikriyaam= perturbation;aatmavipathi shankayaa= doubting about possible shock to his;suhR^ijjanasya=
friends;atra= here;samiikshhya= understanding;taam= that;aagataam= incoming;arthavipathim= disaster in truth.



    
  
  Rama on hearing the harsh and cruel words of Kaikeyi remains unruffled. He asks Kaikeyi sorrowfuly about the reason the king did not speak to him directly about the matter. He then immediately decides to leave for forest after duly saluting the king and Kaikeyi. On the way to forest He desires to visit his mother and Sita and inform them of his decision.

  Ayodhya Kanda · Sarga 17
  This chapter further describes journey towards the royal palace
  This chapter further describes journey towards the royal palace. On the way Rama hears blessings and well meaning words of his friends and various people gathered there.

1Ayodhya Kanda 17.1
स रमो रथमास्थाय सम्प्रहृष्टसुहृञनः |पताकाध्वजसंपन्नं महार्हगुरुधूपितम्अपश्यन्नगरं श्रीमान् नानाजनसमाकुलम्
sa rāmaḥ ratham āsthāya samprahRṣṭa suhRj janaḥ |patākādhvajasaṃpannaṃ mahārhagurudhūpitamapaśyan nagaram śrīmān nānā jana samākulam
Rama the glorious man, who was with his joyful friends, ascended the chariot and saw
the city which was decorated with flags and banners, which was perfumed all around by burning excellent
aloe wood and which was endowed with varied types of people.


Word by word
1. raamaH= Rama;sriimaan the glourious man;samprahR^ishhTa suhR^ijjanaH= having joyful friends;aasthaaya= ascended ;ratham= the chariot;apashyat= saw;nagaram= the city;pataakaadhavaja sampannam= rich with flags and banners;mahaarhaguru dhuupitam= perfumed with excellent befitting wood;naanaajanasamanvitam= endowed with varied types of people.




2Ayodhya Kanda 17.2
स गृहैरभ्रसंकाशैः पांडुरैरुपशोभितम्राजमार्गं ययौ रामो मध्येनगरुधूपितम्
sa gRhaiḥ abhra samkāśaiḥ pāṇḍuraiḥ upaśobhitamrāja mārgam yayau rāmaḥ madhyena agaru dhūpitam
That Rama went through the royal passage which was incensed with aloe wood. That royal
street was splendid with white houses resembling clouds.


Word by word
2. saH raamaH= that Rama;yayau= went;raajamaargam madhyena= through;middle of royal= passage;agarudhuupitam= which was incensed with aloe 
wood;upashobhitam= splendid;paN^duraiH grihaiH= with white houses;abhrasaN^kaashaiH= resembling like clouds.




3Ayodhya Kanda 17.3
चन्दनानाम् च मुख्यानामगुरूणाम् च संचयैः
candanānām ca mukhyānāmagurūṇām ca saṃcayaiḥ
Rama entered that excellent royal route, which was filled with sandal, superior aloe-wood,
excellent perfumes, silk and linen cloth, heaps of them, unpierced pearls, excellent things made of
crystal, splendid with various kinds of flowers and eatables and which was not congested.


Word by word
3;4;5. tam= that;uttamam= excellent;raajapatham= royal route;samvritam= filled with;chandanaanaam= sandal;mukhyaanaam= superior;aguruuNaam= aloe-wood;uttamaanaam= excellent;gandhaanaam= perfumes;kshhoumakaushaam barashya cha= silk and linen cloth;sanchayaiH= heeps 
of them;aviddhaabhiH= unpiereced;muktaabhiH= unpiereced;muktaabhiH= 
pearls;uttamaiH= excellent;sphatikairapi= things made of crystal;shobhamaanam= splendid with;vividhaiH= various kinds of;pusshpaiH= flowers;uchaavachaiH= various kinds of;bhakshhaiH= eatables.




4Ayodhya Kanda 17.4
उत्तमानां च गन्धानां क्षौमकौशाम्बरस्य च |अविद्धाभिश्च मुक्ताभिरुत्तमैः स्फाटिकैरपि
uttamānām ca gandhānāṃ kṣaumakauśāmbarasya ca |aviddhābhiśca muktābhiruttamaiḥ sphāṭikairapi
The source page does not carry a separate English translation for this shloka. The Devanagari and IAST are complete.


5Ayodhya Kanda 17.5
शोभमानसम्बाधं तं राजपथमुत्तमम् |संवृतं विविधैः पुष्पैभ्रुक्ष्यैरुच्चावचैरपि
śobhamānam asambādham tam rāja patham uttamam |samvRtam vividhaiḥ paṇyaiḥ bhakṣyaiḥ ucca avacaiḥ api
The source page does not carry a separate English translation for this shloka. The Devanagari and IAST are complete.


6Ayodhya Kanda 17.6
ददर्श तं राजपथं दिवि देवपतिर्यथा |दध्यक्षतहविर्लाजैर्धूपैरगुरुचंदनैःनानामाल्योपगंधैश्च सदाभ्यर्चितचत्वरम्
dadarśa taṃ rājapathaṃ divi devapatham yathā |dadhyakṣatahavirlājairdhūpairagurucaṃdanaiḥnānāmālyopagaṃdhaiśca sadābhyarcitacatvaram
Rama saw that royal route like divine passage in heaven. All the road junctions there
were regularly worshipped with yoghurt, unbroken rice, clarified butter, fried grain, incense, aloe
and sandal and all types of garlands and perfumes.


Word by word
6. dadarsha= (Rama) saw;tam raajapatham= that royal passage;devapatham yathaa= like divine passage;divi= in heaven;abhyarahita chatvaram= whose road junctions were worshipped;sadaa= perpetually;dadhyakshhata havirlaajaiH= with yoghurt;unbroken rice;clarified butter;fried grain;dhuupaiH= incense;aguruchandanaiH= aloe and sandal wood;naanaa maalyopagandhaishcha= and all types of garlands and perfumes.




7Ayodhya Kanda 17.7
आशीर्वादान् बहून् शृण्वन् सुहृद्भिः समुदीरितान्यथार्हं चापि सम्पूज्य सर्वानेव नारान् ययौं
āśīr vādān bahūn śRṇvan suhRdbhiḥ samudīritānyathā arham ca api sampūjya sarvān eva narān yayau
Hearing the various blessing words spoken by his friends, he went acknowledging all those
people suitably.


Word by word
7. shR^iNvan= hearing;bahuun= various;aashiirvaadaan= blessings;samudiiritaan= spoken;suhR^idbhiH= by friends;yayau= (he) 
went;sampuujyacha= acknowledging;sarvaanena= all;naraan= people;yathaarham= according to merit.




8Ayodhya Kanda 17.8
पितामहैराचरितं तथैव प्रपितामहैःअध्योपादाय तं मार्गमभिषित्तोऽनुपालय
pitāmahaiḥ ācaritam tathaiva prapitāmahaiḥadya upādāya tam mārgam abhiṣiktaḥ anupālaya
"Get coronated today, take the path followed by your grandfathers and great grandfathers
and rule the kingdom."


Word by word
8. abhishhiktaH= get coronated;adya= today;upaadaaya= take;tam maargam= that path;aacharitam= followed pitaamahaiH = by grandfathers;tathaiva= and likewise;prapitaamahaiH= by greatgrandfathers;ampaalaya= and preserve(kingdom).




9Ayodhya Kanda 17.9
यथा स्म पोषिताः पित्रा यथा पूर्वैः पितामहैःततः सुखतरं सर्वे रामे वत्स्याम राजनि
yathā sma lālitāḥ pitrā yathā pūrvaiḥ pitāmahaiḥtataḥ sukhataram sarve rāme vatsyāma rājani
"If Rama becomes king, we shall be more happy than when his father ruled and also when
his grandfathers ruled.


Word by word
9. raame= Rama;raajanisati= being king;vatsyaamaH= (we shall) dwell;sukhataram= happily further;tataH= than that;pitraa= by father;yathaa= in which way;poshhitaasma= we were ruled;yathaa= by which way;sarvaiH= by all;pitaamahaiH= grandfathers.




10Ayodhya Kanda 17.10
अलमद्य हि भुक्तेन परमार्थैरलं च नःयथा पश्याम निर्यान्तं रामं राज्ये प्रतिष्ठितम्
alamadya hi bhuktena parama arthaiḥ alam ca naḥyathā paśyāma niryāntam rāmam rājye pratiṣṭhitam
"If we can see Rama going forth in the city after getting coronated today, it is enough
of eating or other activities."


Word by word
10. pashyaamayadi= if we can see;raamam= Rama;niryaantam= going forth in city;pratisThitam= being established;raajye= in kingdom;adya= today;alam= it is enough;bhuktena= of eating;alam= it is 
enough;paramaarthaiH= of other concerns.




11Ayodhya Kanda 17.11
ततो हि न प्रियतरं नान्यत्किंचिद्भविश्यतियथाभिषेको रामस्य राज्येनामिततेजसः
tataḥ hi na priyataram na anyat kiṃcit bhaviṣyatiyathā abhiṣeko rāmasya rājyena amita tejasaḥ
"There is no other dearer thing to us than coronation of Rama of unbounded splendour".


Word by word
11. kimchit= "which anyat = other thing;nabhavishhyati= is 
not about to be;priyataram= dearer;natt= to us;yathaa= as;abhishhekaH= coronation;raajyena= in kingdom;raamasya= of Rama;annitachetasaH= 
of unbounded spleadour.




12Ayodhya Kanda 17.12
एताश्चान्याश्च शुहृदामुदासीनः सुभाः कथाःआत्मसम्पूजनीः शृण्वन् ययौ रामो महापथम्
etāḥ ca anyāḥ ca suhRdām udāsīnaḥ kathāḥ śubhāḥātma sampūjanīḥ śRṇvan yayau rāmaḥ mahā patham
Rama, though hearing of these good, words spoken by his friends about himself was passive
and went in royal route.


Word by word
12. raamaH= Rama;shriNvan= hearing;etaaH= these;anyaashcha= other;shubhaaH= good;kathaaH= tales ;suhR^idaam= from friends;aatma sampuujaniiH= adoring oneself;udaasiinaH= was passive;yayau= went;mahaapatham= in royal route.




13Ayodhya Kanda 17.13
नहि तस्मान्मनः कश्चिच्चक्षुषी वा नरोत्तमात्नरः रोशवनोत्यपाक्रष्टुमातिक्रान्तोऽपि राघवे
na hi tasmān manaḥ kaścic cakṣuṣī vā nara uttamātnaraḥ śaknoti apākraṣṭum atikrānte api rāghave
Though Rama became distant, no one could turn back one's eyes and mind from him, the
best of men.


Word by word
13. raaghave atikraante api= though Rama has gone distantly;kashchit 
naraH= which man;na shaknotihi= was not able;apaakrashhTum= to turn back;chakshhushhii= eyes;manaH= mind;tasmaat= that;narottamaat= best of men.




14Ayodhya Kanda 17.14
यश्च रामं न पश्येत्तु यं च रामो न पश्यतिनिन्दतः सर्वलोकेषु स्वात्माप्येनं विगर्हते
yaśca rāmaṃ na paśyettu yaṃ ca rāmo na paśyatinindataḥ sarvalokeṣu svātmāpyenam vigarhate
All the people blamed the one who did not see Rama and the one who was not seen by Rama.
Such a person would blame himself of it.


Word by word
14. yashcha= who;napashyethu= did not see;raamam= Rama;yamcha= and to whom;raamaH= Rama;napashyati= did not see;ninditaH= was blamed;sarvalokeshhu= among all people;svaatmaapi= one's 
mind also;vigarhate= yould blame;enam= oneself.




15Ayodhya Kanda 17.15
सर्वेषाम् स हि धर्मात्मा वर्णानां कुरुते दयाम्चतुर्णां हि वयह्स्थानाम् तेन ते तमनुव्रता
sarveṣām sa hi dharma ātmā varṇānām kurute dayāmcaturṇām hi vayahsthānām tena te tam anuvratāḥ
Rama, the virtuous, had compassion towards all the four classes of men and towards the
aged people. Hence, they were all devoted to him.


Word by word
15. saH= that Rama;dharmaatmaa= the virtuous;kurute dayaa= took pity on;sarveshhu= all men;chaturNaami= of four;varNaanaam= 
classes;vayasthaanam= towards the aged;tena= hence;te= they;anuvartaaH= were devoted;tam= to him.




16Ayodhya Kanda 17.16
चत्पुष्पथान् देवपथांश्चैत्यांश्चायतनानि चप्रदक्षिणं परिहरन् जगाम नृपतेस्सुतः
catpuṣpathān devapathāṃścaityānyāyatanāni capradakṣiṇam pariharan jagāma nṛpatessutaḥ
Rama went by crossing road junction, god's paths, sacred trees and temples keeping his
right side towards them.


Word by word
16. nnapate sutaH= Rama;the prince jagaama= went;pariharam= by crossing;chatushhpathaan= road junctions;devapathaan= god's paths;chaityaan= sacred trees;aayatanaanicha= and temples;pradakshhiNam= keeping his;right side 
towards them.




17Ayodhya Kanda 17.17
स राजकुलमासाद्य मेघसंघोपमैः शुभैः
sa rāja kulam āsādya mahā indra bhavana upamam
Rama approached the royal abode and entered his father's palace which was the best palace
with blazing radiance like the palace of king of celestials on earth. All around the house, there were
various types turrets looking like Mount Kailasa, as group of clouds, as white heavenly cars touching
the sky. There were royal houses named vardhamana which were adorned with a net of precious stones.


Word by word
17;18;19. raajaputraH= that Rama;aasaadya= approached;raajakulam= royal abode;pravivesha= entered;tat= that;pituH veshma= father's palace;gR^ihavaram= which was the best palace;jvalan= blazing;shriyaa= with radiance;mahendra sadanopamam= like palace of Indra;the king of 
celestials pR^ithivyaam= on earth;vividhaiH= various types of ;praasaada shR^iN^gaiH= turrets;shubhaiH= which were auspicious;kailaasa shikharo pamaiH= looking like 
mount Kailasa;maghasamghopamaiH= as group of clouds;paaNduraiH vimaanairiva= as 
white heavenly cars;aavaarayadbhiH= covering;gaganam= the sky;vardhamaanagR^ihaishchaapi= also with royal houses named vardhamana;ratnajaala parishhkR^itaiH= adorned with a net 
of jewels.




18Ayodhya Kanda 17.18
प्रासादशृङ्गैर्विविधैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः |आवारयद्भिर्गनं विमानैरिव पाण्डुरैः
prāsādaśpaṅgairvividhaiḥ kailāsaśikharopamaiḥ |āvārayadbhi rganaṃ vimānairiva pāṇḍuraiḥ
The source page does not carry a separate English translation for this shloka. The Devanagari and IAST are complete.


19Ayodhya Kanda 17.19
वर्धमानगृहैश्चापि रत्नजालपरिष्कृतैः |तत्पृथिव्यां गृहवरं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्राजपुत्रः पितुर्वेश्म प्रविवेश श्रिया ज्वलन्
vardhamānagṛhaiścāpi ratna jālapariṣkṛtaiḥ |tatpṛthivyāṃ gṛhavaraṃ mahendrasadanopamamrāja putraḥ pitur veśma praviveśa śriyā jvalan
The source page does not carry a separate English translation for this shloka. The Devanagari and IAST are complete.


20Ayodhya Kanda 17.20
स कक्ष्या धन्विभिर्गुप्तास्तिस्रोऽतिक्रम्य वाजिभिःपदातिरपरे कक्ष्ये द्वे जगाम नरोत्तमः
sa kakṣyā dhanvibhirguptāstisro.atikramya vājibhiḥpadātirapare kakṣye dve jagāma narottamaḥ
Rama the best of men crossed with chariot three enclosures protected by men armed with
bows and moved over the other two enclosures by foot.


Word by word
20. saH= that Rama;narottamaH= the best of men;atikramya= crossed vaajibhiH = with horses;tinraH kakshhyaaH= three enclosures;guptaaH= 
guarded;dhanvibhiH= by men armed with bows;jagaama= got;apare= other;dve kakshhye= two enclosures;guptaaH= guarded;dhanvibhiH= by men armed 
with bows;jagaama= got;apare= other;dve kakshhye= two enclosures;padaatiH= by foot.




21Ayodhya Kanda 17.21
स सर्वाः समतिक्रम्य कक्ष्या दशरथात्मजःसंनिवर्त्य जनं सर्वं शुद्धान्तःपुरुमत्यगात्
sa sarvāḥ samatikramya kakṣyā daśaratha ātmajaḥsamnivartya janam sarvam śuddha antaḥ puram abhyagāt
That Rama passed over all the gates, sent all the people back and entered the palace.


Word by word
21. saH dasharathaatmajaH= that Rama;samatikramya= crossed;sarvaaH= all;kakshhyaaH= gates;samnivartya= sent back;sarvam janam= all people;abhyagaat= veached;shuddhaantaH puram= the palace.




22Ayodhya Kanda 17.22
तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे पितुर्न्तिकं तदा |जनः स सर्वो मुदितो नृपात्मजे |प्रतीक्षते तस्य पुनः स्म निर्गमम् |यथोदयं चन्द्रमसः सरित्पतिः
tasmin praviṣṭe pitur antikam tadā |janaḥ sa sarvo muditaḥ nRpa ātmaje |pratīkṣate tasya punaḥ sma nirgamam |yathā udayam candramasaḥ sarit patiḥ
When Rama went nearer to his father, all the people there were delighted waiting for
his return as the ocean waits for raising of the moon.


Word by word
22. tadaa= then;tasmin= that;nR^ipaatmaje= prince;pravishhTe= went;antikam= nearer;pituH= to father;saH sarvaH= all those;janaH= people;muditaH= wer delighted;pratiikshhatesma= 
waited;punaH nirgamam= for exit again;chandramasaH udryam yathaa = as of rising of moon saritpatiH 
= the ocean.



    
  
  This chapter further describes journey towards the royal palace. On the way Rama hears blessings and well meaning words of his friends and various people gathered there.

Home/Ayodhya Kanda/Sarga 15

  Ayodhya Kanda · Sarga 15
  In this chapter, Sumantra enters the royal court…
  In this chapter, Sumantra enters the royal court and observes all the arrangements made for the coronation of Sri Rama. Ordered by Dasaratha to fetch Sri Rama, he enters the mighty building of Sri Rama.
  49 shlokas≈ 27 minDevanagari completeEnglish 80%

1Ayodhya Kanda 15.1
ते तु ताम् रजनीम् उष्य ब्राह्मणा वेद पारगाः |उपतस्थुर् उपस्थानम् सह राज पुरोहिताः
te tu tām rajanīm uṣya brāhmaṇā veda pāragāḥ |upatasthur upasthānam saha rāja purohitāḥ
Those brahmans skilled in Vedas stayed there all the night and arrived at a nearby place
along with the royal priest, Vashishta.


Word by word
1. te= these;brahmaNaaH= brahmanas;vedapaaragaaH= skilled in vedas;ushhya= stayed;taam rajiniim= for whole night;upatasthuH= and arrived;upasthaanam= at nearby place;saha raaja purohitaaH= along with royal 
priest;Vasista.




2Ayodhya Kanda 15.2
अमात्या बल मुख्याः च मुख्या ये निगमस्य च |राघवस्य अभिषेक अर्थे प्रीयमाणाः तु सम्गताः
amātyā bala mukhyāḥ ca mukhyā ye nigamasya ca |rāghavasya abhiṣeka arthe prīyamāṇāḥ tu samgatāḥ
Ministers, army chiefs, prominent leaders of the city assembled there, welcoming the
cause of Rama's coronation.


Word by word
2. amaatyaaH= ministers;balamukhyaasheha= army chiefs;ye= which;mukyaaH= prominent leaders;nigamasya= of the city (those people);samgataaH= assembled;priyamaaNaaH= welcoming;abhishhekaarthe= cause 
of Rama's coronation.




3Ayodhya Kanda 15.3
उदिते विमले सूर्ये पुष्ये च अभ्यागते अहनि |अभिषेकाय रामस्य द्विज इन्द्रैः उपकल्पितम्कान्चना जल कुम्भाः च भद्र पीठम् स्वलम्क्ऱ्तम्
udite vimale sūrye puṣye ca abhyāgate ahani |abhiṣekāya rāmasya dvija indraiḥ upakalpitamkāncanā jala kumbhāḥ ca bhadra pīṭham svalamkRtam
The best of brahmanas were prepared to do Rama's coronation in day-time after the sun
rises clearly at the arrival of Pushya star and on arrival of Rama's auspicious birth time of Cancer.


Word by word
3. raamasya= Rama's;abhishhekaaya= coronation;upakalpitam= arranged by;dvijendraiH= the best of brahmanas;udite= after rising;suurye= of sun;vimale= clearly;abhyaagate= on arrival of ;pushhyecha= pushyami 
star;praapte= and after arrival of;raamasya= Rama's;janma= birth;sthite= position;karkatakalagne= of auspicious time of cancer.




4Ayodhya Kanda 15.4
काञ्चना जलकुमाभश्च भद्रपीठं स्वलङ्कृतम्रथश्च सम्यगा स्तीर्णोभास्वता व्याग्रचर्मणा
kāñcanā jalakumābhaśca bhadrapīṭhaṃ svalaṅkṛtamrathaśca samyagā stīrṇobhāsvatā vyāgracarmaṇā
Golden water-pots, well-decorated throne and chariot covered well by shining tiger-skin
were impressive.


Word by word
4. kaaJNchanaa= golden;jala kumbhaasheha= water pots;svalaNkR^itam= well decorated;bhadrapiitham= throne;rathashcha= and the 
chariot;aastiirNaH= covered by;bhaaasvataa= shining;vyaaghracharmaNaa= tiger-skin.




5Ayodhya Kanda 15.5
गङ्गायमुनयोः पुण्यात्सङ्गमादाहृतं जलम्
gaṅgāyamunayoḥ puṇyātsaṅgamādāhṛtaṃ jalam
Water was brought from auspicious conjunction of rivers ganga and Yamuna, from other
rivers, lakes, wells, ponds, from streams flowing eastwards, from streams which joined together and
from oceans in all sides.


Word by word
5;6. jalam= water;aahR^itam= brought from;puNyaat= auspicious;gangaayammayoH saN^gaat= conjuction of ganga and yamuna rivers;yaaH= which;anyaaH= other;saritaH= rivers(from them);hradaaH= lakes;kuupaaH= wells;saraamsicha= ponds;pragvaahaaH= those flowing upwards;tiryagvaahaaH= those flowing crossward;samaahitaaH= from those which joined together;taabhyaH cha= from them;samudrebhyaH cha= and from oceans;sarvashaH= 
from all sides;toyam= water;ahR^itam= was brought.




6Ayodhya Kanda 15.6
याश्चान्याः सरितः पुण्या ह्रदाः कूपाः सरांसि च |प्राग्वाहाश्चोर्ध्ववाहाश्च तिर्यग्वाहा स्समाहिताःताभ्यश्चैवाहृतं तो यं समुद्रेभ्यश्च सर्वशः
yāścānyāḥ saritaḥ puṇyā hradāḥ kūpāḥ sarāṃsi ca |prāgvāhāścordhvavāhāśca tiryagvāhā ssamāhitāḥtābhyaścaivāhṛtaṃ to yaṃ samudrebhyaśca sarvaśaḥ
The source page does not carry a separate English translation for this shloka. The Devanagari and IAST are complete.


7Ayodhya Kanda 15.7
सलाजाः क्षीरिभिश्छन्ना घटाः काञ्चनराजताःपद्मोत्पलयुता भान्ति पूर्णाः परमवारिणा
salājāḥ kṣīribhiśchannā ghaṭāḥ kāñcanarājatāḥpadmotpalayutā bhānti pūrṇāḥ paramavāriṇā
Gold and silver pots filled with best water together with popped grain and covered by
milky sapped leaves, lotuses and water-lilies were shining there.


Word by word
7. kaaN^chana raajataaH= gold and silver;ghataaH= pots;puurNaaH= filled with;paramavaariNaa= excellent water;salaajaaH= together 
with popped grain;chhannaaH= covered by;kshiiribhiH= milky sapped leaves;padmotpalayutaaH= along;with lotuses and water lilies;bhaanti= were shining.




8Ayodhya Kanda 15.8
क्षौद्रं दधि घृतं लाजा दर्भाः सुमनसः पयःवेश्याश्चैव शुभाचाराः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः
kṣaudraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ lājā darbhāḥ sumanasaḥ payaḥveśyāścaiva śubhācārāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
Honey, curd, clarified butter popped grain, sacred grass, flowers and milk were kept
ready. Harlots adorned with all types of ornaments were also glimmering there.


Word by word
8. kshaudram= honey;dadhi= curd;ghR^itam= clarified 
butter;laajaaH= popped grain;darbhaaH= sacred grass;sumanasaH= flowers;payaH= milk(were glimmering);veshyaaHcha eva= as also harlots;shubhaachaaraaH= with good customs;sarvaabhara Na bhuushhitaaH = and adorned with all types of ornaments.




9Ayodhya Kanda 15.9
चन्द्रांशुविकचप्रख्यं काञ्चनं रत्नभुषितम्सज्जं तिष्ठति रामस्य वालव्यजनमुत्तमम्
candrāṃśuvikacaprakhyaṃ kāñcanaṃ ratnabhuṣitamsajjaṃ tiṣṭhati rāmasya vālavyajanamuttamam
An excellent fly-flopper which was like spread-out rays of moon, made of gold, adorned
with diamonds was kept ready for Rama.


Word by word
9. raamasya= Rama's;uttamam= excellent;vaalavyajanam= fly-flapper;chandraanshu vikachaprakhyam= like spread-out rays of moon;kaanchanam - made 
with gold;ratna bhuushhitam= adorned with diamonds;tishhTati= was kept;sajjam= ready.




10Ayodhya Kanda 15.10
चन्द्रमण्डलसम्काशमातपत्रं च पाण्डुरम्सज्जं द्युतिकरं श्रीमदभिषेकपुरस्कृतम्
candramaṇḍalasamkāśamātapatraṃ ca pāṇḍuramsajjaṃ dyutikaraṃ śrīmadabhiṣekapuraskṛtam
A white umbrella like circular moon, which was kept in advance for the occasion of coronation
was also kept ready.


Word by word
10. paaN^Duram= white;aatapatramcha= umbrella also;chandramN^dalasankaasham= equal to circular moon dyutikaram = which was shining;shriimat= which was beautifl;abhishhekapuraskR^itam= which was kept in advance for the occasion of coronation;sajjam= was ready.




11Ayodhya Kanda 15.11
पाण्डुरश्च वृषः सज्जः पाण्डुरोऽस्वश्च सुस्थितःप्रसृतश्च गजः श्रीमानौपवाह्यः प्रतीक्षते
pāṇḍuraśca vṛṣaḥ sajjaḥ pāṇḍuro.asvaśca susthitaḥprasṛtaśca gajaḥ śrīmānaupavāhyaḥ pratīkṣate
A white bull, a white horse a mighty and beautiful elephant which was fit to be mounted
by kings were readily waiting.


Word by word
11. paaN^DuraH= white;vR^ishhaH cha= bull also;sajjaH= was ready;paaN^DuraH= white;ashvaH cha= horse also;susthitaH= was 
in well established position;gajaH cha= elephant also;prasR^itaH= which was mighty;shriimaan= which was beautiful;oupaaahyaH= which was fit to be mounted by kings;pratiikshhate= was waiting.




12Ayodhya Kanda 15.12
अष्टौ च कन्या माङ्गल्याः सर्वाभरणभूषिताःवादित्राणि च सर्वाणि वन्दिनश्च तथापरे
aṣṭau ca kanyā māṅgalyāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥvāditrāṇi ca sarvāṇi vandinaśca tathāpare
Eight auspicious virgins adorned all types of ornaments, various types of musical instruments,
panegyrists and others were also waiting.


Word by word
12. ashhTau= eight;maaN^galyaaH= auspicious;kanyaaH= virgins;sarvaabharaNa bhuushhitaaH= adorned with all types of ornaments;sarvaaNi= all types of;vaaditraaNi= musical instruments;vandinaH cha= panegyrishts;tathaa= and;pare= others;(were waiting)




13Ayodhya Kanda 15.13
इक्ष्वाकूणां यथा राज्ये संभ्रियेताभिषेचनम्
ikṣvākūṇāṃ yathā rājye saṃbhriyetābhiṣecanam
The people who gathered there after getting the things required as per orders of king
for coronation ceremony to be held in a kingdom of Ikshhvaaku dynasty, could not sight the king and
discussed among themselves about how to inform the king regarding their arrival.


Word by word
13;14. te= they;samavetaaH= who gathered;tatra= 
there;aadaaya= getting;raajaputraabhishhechanam= the things required for coronation 
cermony;raaja vachanaat= as per insturctions of king;tathaajaatiiyam = of such a kind;abhishhechanam= of things required for coronation;yathaa= as;sambhriyeta = collected;raajye= in kingdom;ikshhvakuuNaam= of Ikshhvaaku dynasty;apashyamtaH= could not see;mahiipatim= the kings;abruvam= spoke;kaH nu= who;pratipaadayet= will inform;raajJNo= the king;naH= about us.




14Ayodhya Kanda 15.14
तथाजातीयमादाय राजपुत्राभिषेचन्म् |ते राजवचनात्तत्र समवेता महीपतिम्अपश्यन्तोऽब्रुवन् को बु राज्ञोनः प्रतिपादयेत्
tathājātīyamādāya rājaputrābhiṣecanm |te rājavacanāttatra samavetā mahīpatimapaśyanto.abruvan ko bu rājñonaḥ pratipādayet
The source page does not carry a separate English translation for this shloka. The Devanagari and IAST are complete.


15Ayodhya Kanda 15.15
न पश्यामश्च राजानमुदितश्च दिवाकरःयौवराज्याभिषेकश्च सज्जो रामस्य धीमतः
na paśyāmaśca rājānamuditaśca divākaraḥyauvarājyābhiṣekaśca sajjo rāmasya dhīmataḥ
" The king is not being seen. The sun has risen. Everything is ready for the coronation
of Rama, the wise".


Word by word
15. nacha pashyaamaH= (we are ) not seeing;raajaanam= the 
king;divaakaraH cha= the sun also;uditahH= has risen;dhiimataH= the 
wise;raamasya= Rama's yauvaraajyaabhishhekaH cha = crowing ceremony also;sajjaH - is ready.




16Ayodhya Kanda 15.16
इति तेषु ब्रुवाणेषु सार्वभौमान् महीपतीन्अब्रवीत्तानिदं सर्वान्सुमन्त्रो राजसत्कृतः
iti teṣu bruvāṇeṣu sārvabhaumān mahīpatīnabravīttānidaṃ sarvānsumantro rājasatkṛtaḥ
Sumantra, who received good respect from Dasaratha, heard them thus speaking and addressed
those kings, who came from different countries.


Word by word
16. teshhu bruvaaNeshu= while they were speaking;iti= thus;sumantraH= sumantra;raaja satkR^itaH= who is well respected by king;abraviit= spoke;idam= these words;taan mahiipatiin= to those kings;sarvaan saarvaabhaumaan= who belong to all countries entirely.




17Ayodhya Kanda 15.17
रामं राज्ञो नियोगेन त्वरया प्रस्थितोऽस्म्यहम्पूज्या राज्ञो भवन्तस्तु रामस्य च विशेषतः
rāmaḥ ca samyag āstīrṇo bhāsvarā vyāghra carmaṇāgangā yamunayoh puṇyāt samgamāt āhRtam jalam
"I am going to Rama quickly as per king's directions. But, you are all worthy of worship
by Dasaratha and by Rama in particular."


Word by word

ततोऽद्रिकूटाचलमेघसन्नि भं |महाविमानोपमवेश्मसंयुतम् |अवार्यमाणः प्रविवेश सारथिः |प्रभूतरत्नं मकरो यथार्णवम्
tato.adrikūṭācalameghasanni bhaṃ |mahāvimānopamaveśmasaṃyutam |avāryamāṇaḥ praviveśa sārathiḥ |prabhūtaratnaṃ makaro yathārṇavam

  In this chapter, Sumantra enters the royal court and observes all the arrangements made for the coronation of Sri Rama. Ordered by Dasaratha to fetch Sri Rama, he enters the mighty building of Sri Rama.

1Ayodhya Kanda 13.1
अतदर्हं महाराजं शयानम् सयानमतथोचितम् |ययातिमिव पुण्यान्ते देवलोकात्परिच्युतम्
atat arham mahā rājam śayānam atathā ucitam |yayātim iva puṇya ante deva lokāt paricyutam
Dasaratha was not suitable for such an unfortunate condition nor was he habituated
to such a situation. He was lying down on the floor, as king Yayati who fell down on earth fter
exhausting his merit in the region of heaven. Kaikeyi who was a manifestation of worthlessness who
accomplished her desire, who was fearlessly exhibiting her fearful form, asked for those boons
again in a loud voice, to Dasaratha who was in such a bad mood situation.


Word by word

manifesting of worthlessness ;siddhaarthaa= who accomplished her desire;abhiita= who was without fear;bhayadarshinii= who exhibited fear;aakaarayaamaasa= informed ;tameva varam= those boons;punaH= again;mahaaraajan= to Dasaratha;atadarsham= who was unsuitable for it;atathochim= who was not habitated to such a situation;shayaanam= who was lying
down on floor;yayaatimiva= as king Yayati;parichyutam= who dropped;devalokaat= from heaven;puNyaante= after exhausting his merit.




2Ayodhya Kanda 13.2

anartha rūpā siddha arthāabhītā bhaya darśinī |punar ākārayām āsa tam eva varam anganā

tvam katthase mahā rāja satya vādī dRḍha vrataḥ |mama ca imam varam kasmāt vidhārayitum iccasi
"Oh, king! You always boast yourself, saying "I speak truth. I am persisted in my
promise." Now, why are you objecting to my boon?"

एवमुक्तस्तु कैकेय्या राजा दशरथस्तदा |प्रत्युवाच ततः क्रुद्धो मुहूर्तं विह्वलन्निव

5Ayodhya Kanda 13.5
मृते मयि गते रामे वनं मनुजपुंगवे |हन्त अनार्ये मम अमित्रे सकाम सुखिनी भव

21Ayodhya Kanda 13.21
शून्ये न खलु सुश्रोणि मयेदं समुदाहृतम्कुरु साधु प्रसादं मे बाले सहृदया ह्यसि
śūnyena khalu suśroṇi mayā idam samudāhRtamkuru sādhu prasādam me bāle sahRdayā hi asi
"Oh, well-hipped one! I hope that whatever I told, has not merged in the sky. Oh!
young woman, be kind to me . You are good-hearted."


Word by word
21. sushroNi= Oh;the well hipped!;idam= All this;na
khalusamudaatiR^itum= is not indeed addressed to ;shuunye= vacuum!(the sky);baale= Oh;young woman!;kuru= do;prasaadam= favour;me=
to me;saadhu= well;asihi= you are indeed;sahR^idayaa= good
hearted!




22Ayodhya Kanda 13.22
प्रसीद देवि रामो मे त्वद्धत्तं राज्यमव्ययम्लभतामसितापाङ्गे यशः परमवाप्नुहि
prasīda devi rāmo me tvaddhattaṃ rājyamavyayamlabhatāmasitāpāṅge yaśaḥ paramavāpnuhi
"Oh, queen with dark outer corner of eyes be kind. You your self give my kingdom to
Rama. Thus, you will obtain great fame."


Word by word
22. devi= Oh;queen!;asitaapaaN^ge= with dark outer
corner of eyes;prasiida= Be kind;raamaH labhataam= Let Rama obtain;me
raajyam= my kingdom;tvaddattam= given by you;avaapnuti= obtain;param= great;yashaH= fame.




23Ayodhya Kanda 13.23
मम रामस्य लोकस्य गुरूणां भरतस्य चप्रियमेतद्गुरुश्रोणि कुरु चारुमुखेक्षणे
mama rāmasya lokasya gurūṇāṃ bharatasya capriyametadguruśroṇi kuru cārumukhekṣaṇe
"Oh, broad hipped, with beautiful face and eyes! do this. It will be pleasing to me,
to Rama, to the world, to priests and to Bharata."


Word by word
23. gurushroNe= Oh;the broad hipped;charumukhekshhaNaa=
with beautiful face and eyes;kuru= do;etat= this;priyam= which
will be pleasing;mama= to me;raamasya= to Rama;lokasya= to the
world;guruuNaam= to priests bharatasyacha = and to Bharata.




24Ayodhya Kanda 13.24
विशुद्धभावस्य सु ुष्टभावा |दीनस्य ताम्राश्रुकलस्य राज्ञः |श्रुत्वा विचित्रं करुणं विलापं |भर्तुर्नृशंसा न चकार वाक्यम्
viśuddha bhāvasya su duṣṭa bhāvā |dīnasya tāmrāśrukalasya rājñḥ |śrutvā vicitram karuṇam vilāpam |bhartur nRśaṃsā na cakāra vākyam
Hearing the king, who was her pure-hearted husband and who was pitifully lamenting
strangely with red eyes filled with tears, that bad tempered cruel woman did not follow his
words.


Word by word
24. sudushhta bhaava= that too bad-tempered;nR^ishamsaa=
cruel woman;vishuddha bhaavasya= that cruel woman;shrutvaa= after hearing;vishuddha bhaavasya= the pure hearted;diinasya= the depressed;bhartuH= the husband;taamrekshhaNasyashru kalasya= with red eyes filled with
tears;karuNam vilaapam= lamenting pitifully;vichitram= in a strange way ;nachakaara= could not follow;vaakyam= the words;raaGyaH= of
king.




25Ayodhya Kanda 13.25
ततः स राजा पुनरेव मूर्छितः |प्रियामतुष्टां प्रतिकूलभाषिणीम् |समीक्ष्य पुत्रस्य विवासनम् प्रति |क्षितौ विसंज्ञो निपपात दुःखितः
tataḥ sa rājā punar eva mūrcitaḥ |priyām atuṣṭām pratikūla bhāṣiṇīm |samīkṣya putrasya vivāsanam prati |kṣitau visamjño nipapāta duhkhitaḥ
Seeing his discontented wife talking unpleasantly about sending Rama to forest, that
king was distressed, fainted again and fell down unconscious on the floor.


Word by word
25. samiikshha= seeing;priyaam= wife;pratikuula
bhashhiniim= who is talking unpleasantly;putrasya vivaasanam prati= about sending
the son to forest;atushhtaam= and who is dissatisfied;saH raajaa= that king;duHkhitaH= was distressed;tataH= and therafter;muurchchhitaH=
fainted;punareva= again;visamGyaH= losing consciousness;nipapaata=
fell down;kshhitau= on floor.




26Ayodhya Kanda 13.26
इतीव राज्ञो व्यथितस्य सा निशा |जगाम घोरं श्वसतो मनस्विनः |विबोध्यमानः प्रतिबोधनं तदा |निवारयामास स राजसत्तमः
itīva rājño vythitasya sā niśā |jagāma ghoraṃ svasato manasvinaḥ |vibodhyamānaḥ pratibodhanaṃ tadā |nivārayāmāsa sa rājasattamaḥ
While the distressed and self-respected king was sighing terribly in the way, that
night came to an end. In the dawn, bards and singers started to awaken him. But the excellent king
prevented them to do.


Word by word
26. itiiva= In this way;vyathitasya= the distressed;manasvinaH= self-respected;raajJNyaH= king;shvasataH= sighing;ghoram= terribly;sa a nishaa= that night;jagaama= exhausted.;raajasattamaH= That excellent king;vibodhyamaavaH= having been awakened;tadaa= then;nivaarayaamaasa= prevented;vibodhanam= the
awakening.

  In this chapter Kaikeyi asks King Dasaratha to fulfill the boons given to her in earlier times.
